inventory_archive: DataLumos project 240526 (inventory modification 2025-06-26; not a release date)
selection_rule: Newest active completed-month EIA-860M workbook link on the producer page; commented and future links are ignored.

aggregation.capacity: sum of numeric nameplate and net summer capacity cells; blank cells excluded
aggregation.primary_technology_and_fuel: largest summed nameplate capacity; lexicographic tie-break; no imputation
aggregation.coordinates: retained only when every generator at the plant has the same non-blank numeric pair; never averaged

geometry: none; native latitude and longitude remain lexical attributes

historical_source.reason: EIA stopped updating the map_data zip; the Energy Atlas replacement layer requires a token and the public Esri copy is not owned by EIA.

source_scope: Current EIA-860M operating-generator inventory aggregated to plants. Equivalence to the historical HIFLD power-plant population is unverified.
open_decisions: producer coordinate datum and spatial release
refresh: Dagster draft schedule is STOPPED. No production publication or release approval is claimed.
